facts.fact: Adwave's agency licenses are priced at $499, $1,999, and $4,999 per month, according to the vendor's own page.
For agencies, media spend is passed through at cost from a single agency wallet, while Adwave bills a license plus published unit prices for ad creation.
facts.quote: Media is pass-through at cost from one agency wallet. Adwave bills a license plus published unit prices for ad creation.

facts.fact: Agency clients on Adwave's Growth and Scale tiers can add a custom host such as ads.harbor.example, while all agencies receive an Adwave subdomain on day one.
facts.quote: We give you an Adwave subdomain on day one. Growth and Scale can add a host such as ads.harbor.example.

facts.fact: Adwave's page states that client data is not pooled across agency client accounts.
facts.quote: Client data is not pooled across accounts.

facts.fact: Adwave's agency white-label page was published on 2026-08-13.
